suggestions.guidance_rule: All employees cannot access other teams' repositories.
suggestions.missing_context: No 'team' field is declared in system_vars.json or any tool schema. The rule requires knowing which team the caller belongs to and which teams own which repositories, neither of which is available at OPA intercept time.
suggestions.reason: This rule cannot be enforced without a 'team' field populated from authenticated identity (e.g., JWT claims via authbridge-cpex sidecar). Additionally, repo-to-team ownership would need to be represented in either tool arguments or a policy data document.

note: These are suggestions for future system variable additions. They are NOT part of the current policy.
